h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Meghalaya

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Meghalaya

c: Few places in India are as wet as Meghalaya, and that shapes how an outdoor gym should be planned here. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness equipment to Shillong, Tura, Jowai and other towns in the Khasi, Jaintia and Garo Hills. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, send them by road and install them through our team or a dealer in the region. Every station is checked at our in-house quality inspection before it leaves.

Buyers here are mostly schools, colleges, churches, community groups, government offices and town authorities. Tourist lodges and resorts outside Shillong ask for a few stations for guests as well. Shillong also has a long tradition of residential schools with big playing fields. On a hill site, the ground decides most of the plan. Send us photos and a rough sketch of the slope, and we will suggest machines that fit and show the clear space each one needs.

richText.heading: Building an outdoor gym for heavy rain and cool weather

c: The monsoon in Meghalaya is long and very heavy, especially around Sohra, and Shillong stays cool for most of the year. Moss and wet leaves make bare concrete slippery, so use a textured or rubber surface around the stations. Galvanised frames resist rust, and roto-moulded parts do not absorb water. A covered spot, such as a shed or one of our gazebos, keeps the gym usable on wet days.

facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment stay outdoors through Meghalaya's monsoon?
items.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and the seats and grips are roto-moulded, both weather-proof. Clear moss and leaves from the base and check bearings after the rains to keep everything moving freely.

items.q: Can we put the gym under a roof?
items.a: Yes, as long as there is enough height and clear space around each machine, and air can move through so the area dries out. We also make gazebos and pergolas in our garden decor range if you need a covered structure.

items.q: How do we start planning an open gym in Shillong?
items.a: Share the site size, a few photos and who will use it. We suggest machines, send a layout drawing and a quote, and then manufacture and install once you approve.
